case.promise: A direct presentation of ClubAL and the Operador module’s move to the web.
case.summary: The website organizes the Windows base, the Operador web platform under validation and the integrated Flet weather feature.

tabs.label: Challenge
tabs.title: Present an evolving product clearly.
tabs.body: The content presents the proposition, the three modules and the Operador module’s move to the web platform.

tabs.label: Architecture
tabs.title: The narrative follows the product architecture.
tabs.body: Operação, Rotinas and Consulta form the current base. The Operador web platform is under validation and incorporates the Flet weather feature.

tabs.label: Delivery
tabs.title: A digital presence ready to evolve with the product.
tabs.body: The website brings together Portuguese, English and Spanish, light and dark themes, responsive layout, local assets and static publishing.
